_about: On-screen hook captions for the six Genjutsu Lite reels, 10 options each (25 Oct 2026). One line break = one spoken beat. The CTA replaces the hook for the last 2 to 3 seconds of every reel. Written in Yarin's calibrated voice (40 rewrites) and his own caption formats from the 19 and 21 Oct reels; lint: carousel/carousel-pipeline/scripts/voice_lint.py.
